editorial: If your favorite part of a rom-com is the moment the perfect plan goes spectacularly wrong, you will find your new obsession in this dark-comedy thriller. When Lienkie’s life falls apart, her devotion to winning 'Bride of the Year' becomes a brilliantly manipulative form of self-preservation. The standout element is the way the script leans fully into the absurdity of the high-stakes competition, turning romance into a strategic, almost sinister game. While the pacing drags slightly during the second act, the sheer wit and electric chemistry between the leads make it worthwhile. This is your perfect viewing experience for a sassy, dramatic night in, proving that sometimes the best kind of love story is the one built on deception.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of sharp ensemble casts who appreciate the satisfying burn of a revenge plot.
